**sdd/issue-244-a4/apply-progress**

**What**: Implemented issue-244-a4 (GitLab substrate ladder awareness) end-to-end, all 8 phases, strict TDD RED→GREEN throughout, THEN addressed a fresh-context review (1 MAJOR + 1 MINOR + 2 NITs) on the same branch. Tasks 1.1-8.4 checked [x] in openspec/changes/issue-244-a4/tasks.md (35/36 boxes; 8.5 `memory:share` left unchecked — pre-push orchestrator step, out of apply's scope). Not committed/pushed (orchestrator handles delivery).

**Why**: Track A / Slice A4 — close the gh-hardcoded rung-1 probe and the selfHostedPreReceive short-circuit dishonesty seams on GitLab, per owner ruling (memory #565) and locked spec/design (memory #568/#569). Review round found the SAME honesty bug (fabricated `false`) one layer below my original fix, at the true source.

**Where** (initial pass — see prior revision for full file list):
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs` — `projectMergeSettings({project})` (glab api projects/:id, null-on-failure/unparsable).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.mjs` — 3 pure evaluators, `evalRung1` OR-composes `gates`, short-circuit removed, `detectSubstrate` mutate-adds `brainWritesReviewed`. `selectRung()` untouched.
- `brain/scripts/brain-governance-status.mjs` — `realBranchProtectionProbe` provider-dispatch, `printSubstrateReport` per-gate rendering.
- `brain/scripts/vcs/fixtures/gitlab-project.json` (new, derived+`_provenance`).
- `docs/inbox/self-hosted-pre-receive.md` — Ladder Awareness subsection.

**Where (review-fix pass, this update)**:
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs#projectMergeSettings` — MAJOR fix: `Boolean(JSON.parse(r.stdout).only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds)` fabricated `false` when a 200+parseable response simply OMITS the field (GitLab permission-gates some project attributes — a real, distinct case from read-failure/unparsable). Fixed to `typeof v === 'boolean' ? v : null` — only a genuine boolean counts as computed, anything else (including a present-but-non-boolean value) is `null` (uncomputable), never fabricated `false`. RED test added first (providers.test.mjs, field-absent-from-successful-read case) — confirmed failing against old `Boolean(...)`, then GREEN.
- `brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.test.mjs` — added a STRONG "propagation proof" test wiring the REAL `gitlab.mjs#projectMergeSettings` (not a fixture double) as the `branchProtection` probe via the shared `setSpawn` seam, asserting directly on `detectSubstrate(...).rungs[1].gates.pipelineMustSucceed` (`available:false`, reason matches `/uncomputable/i`, does NOT match `/is not set/i`). This is the load-bearing regression guard — a text-match test against `reportGovernanceStatus`'s PRINTED output could NOT distinguish the bug from the fix here, because `printSubstrateReport` never renders an INACTIVE rung-1 sub-gate's reason (only active/armed gates get a line, and the top-level `remedy` line comes from `rungs[selectedRung-1]`, not necessarily rung-1's own reason) — discovered this while writing the propagation-proof test in brain-governance-status.test.mjs first and realizing the assertion could pass even with the bug present (weak test). Kept a weaker CLI-level test too (non-throwing + non-false-arming via the real gitlab.mjs), but the STRONG assertion lives in substrate.test.mjs.
- `openspec/changes/issue-244-a4/spec.md` REQ-A4-3 — MINOR fix: corrected stale text claiming the new GitLab read takes `{apiBase, token, proxyUrl}` params "exactly like issueView" — the SHIPPED code (and design.md's own snippet) correctly uses the `glab` CLI session pattern like `capabilities()`/`branchProtect()`, because `brain:governance-status` is a local-dev-only tool (unlike issueView/prView/labelEvents/prReviews, which are CI-portable because CI gates actually invoke them glab-lessly). Corrected the requirement prose + Scenario 1's GIVEN/THEN to match the shipped, correct code. No code change — spec text was stale, not the implementation.
- `brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.mjs` NIT 1 fix — `evalRung1`'s not-active return had `available: active || primary.available` where `active` is always `false` in that branch (guarded by the preceding `if (active) return`) — simplified to `available: primary.available`. Dead-code removal, no behavior change (proven — `active` was provably always false there).
- `brain/scripts/brain-governance-status.mjs` NIT 2 fix — removed the unreachable `if (gates.preReceive.verifiable) { ...'server hook detected'... }` branch in `printSubstrateReport` (evalPreReceiveGate always sets `verifiable:false`, so this branch could never execute) — a latent "detected/verified" path that contradicted A4's entire honesty theme. No test referenced that dead text; removal is safe.

**Learned**:
1. Fresh-context review is valuable precisely because in-context TDD can prove a downstream fix (my substrate.mjs three-way ladder) correct while missing that the SAME class of bug (null→false coercion) exists one layer below, at the true I/O boundary (gitlab.mjs) — the ladder was only ever receiving the ALREADY-coerced `false`, never the honest `null`, so my original "uncomputable" test in substrate.test.mjs passed by injecting a hand-crafted probe result, not by exercising the real function — a false sense of coverage.
2. When adding a "propagation proof" test, verify FIRST that the assertion can actually distinguish bug-present from bug-fixed behavior by re-reading what the target function DOES render/expose — don't assume "the printed report will show X" without checking; `printSubstrateReport` only renders ACTIVE rung-1 sub-gates, never inactive ones' reasons, and the top-level `remedy` comes from `rungs[selectedRung-1]` (the rung below the one that won selection), not necessarily the specific sub-gate under test. Introspecting `detectSubstrate()`'s returned `gates` object directly (already exported/testable) is the strong assertion path; CLI-output text-matching is only a sanity check (non-throwing, no false-arming) when the target field never reaches the console.
3. `design.md`'s own REQ-A4-3-adjacent claim about `{apiBase,token,proxyUrl}` params in spec.md was pre-existing DRIFT from Phase 2 (tasks/spec writing) — the actual design.md Decision 2 snippet was always correct (glab-session pattern); only spec.md's prose had copied the wrong precedent (issueView) instead of the right one (capabilities()/branchProtect()). Worth noting for future spec-writing: cite the CORRECT sibling precedent explicitly by name, not just "exactly like X" without checking X actually applies (CI-portable GATE_FILE verbs vs local-dev-only session verbs are NOT the same class).

**Final verification (post-review-fix)**: `npm test` **1219/1219 pass, 0 fail** (was 1216 before this fix round, +3: 1 gitlab.mjs field-absent test, 1 substrate.mjs propagation-proof test, 1 brain-governance-status.mjs propagation-sanity test). `brain:repo:check` green. `brain:nav` green. Behavior-preservation reconfirmed: `git diff --unified=0` on substrate.test.mjs shows only an import-statement change (adding `afterEach`/`setSpawn`/`gitlab` imports) — zero pre-existing test bodies/assertions touched. Non-test counted diff (authoritative `parseDiffNumstat` + brain.config.json ignoreList, vs `origin/feature/v2.0.0`) = **267/400** (was 258 before this fix round; +9 from the gitlab.mjs fix's extra guard/comment lines, net-neutral from the two NIT removals). Not committed — orchestrator handles delivery.
